consequence.statement: Lambda-Promtail deployments can now ingest AWS WAF logs from S3 buckets; this is an additive feature with no impact on existing configurations.

original.statement: Loki 3.0.0 adds support for AWS WAF logs stored in S3 to Lambda-Promtail.

decision.reason: [ev-c63a71bf0be5] lists this only under 3.0.0 Features, as new Lambda-Promtail support for WAF logs in S3. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated. An operator who does nothing just doesn't use the new capability, so "none" (informational) is the right kind. The claim of "no impact on existing configurations" is inferred from the line being additive, not stated outright, which is why confidence is low.
